now = datetime.datetime.now()
print(now)

    last_day = now.replace(year=now.year+1, month=1, day=1) - datetime.timedelta(days=1)
else:

last_day_str = last_day.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
print(first_day, last_day_str)
